definitions.gloss: repair cost; maintenance expense; repair fee
definitions.explanation: The cost incurred for repairing or maintaining buildings, equipment, or other property. A standard term in real estate, accounting, and property management.

examples.japanese: ⟦マンション→マンション：01035_manshon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{修繕費|しゅうぜんひ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{値上|ねあ}がり→値上がり：11538_neagari⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The condominium repair fees went up.

examples.japanese: ⟦{老朽化|ろうきゅうか}→老朽化：07646_roukyuuka⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{修繕費|しゅうぜんひ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧かさむ。
examples.english: Repair costs add up for aging buildings.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{修繕|しゅうぜん}→修繕：06569_shuuzen⟧ (repair, mending) + ⟦{費|ひ}→費：09877_hi⟧ (cost, expense). Very commonly encountered in real estate and condominium management. In Japanese condominiums (⟦{分譲|ぶんじょう}→分譲：06577_bunjou⟧⟦マンション→マンション：01035_manshon⟧), residents pay a monthly {修繕積立金|しゅうぜんつみたてきん} (repair reserve fund) for future building maintenance.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {修繕費|しゅうぜんひ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{負担|ふたん}→負担：09752_futan⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to bear repair costs
- {修繕費|しゅうぜんひ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧: to incur repair costs
- {修繕積立金|しゅうぜんつみたてきん}: repair reserve fund
- ⟦{大規模|だいきぼ}→大規模：12185_daikibo⟧⟦{修繕|しゅうぜん}→修繕：06569_shuuzen⟧: large-scale repair/renovation

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{管理費|かんりひ}→管理費：06575_kanrihi⟧: management fee
- ⟦{維持費|いじひ}→維持費：23066_ijihi⟧: maintenance cost
- {修理代|しゅうりだい}: repair charge (more informal)
